scope: N01 X0 whole-application typed wire adapter; synthetic two-tick completion, not physical throughput or device startup
renderer: unchanged 128x64 page bytes, 3x5 glyph, 32-byte data payload

display.window: per chunk horizontal column/page bounds; 9 command bytes including control

measurement.calibration_assumption: upstream calibration 4096 and declared 10 milliohm shunt -> 1 mA/LSB; calibration not written by this adapter
measurement.publish: both reads successful; failed pair keeps previous application value and marks stale
measurement.freshness: not inferred from read opportunity or CNVR; two registers are not a coherent conversion snapshot
measurement.quality: raw words are synthetic input; analog accuracy, calibration validity and OVF/CNVR interpretation are not certified

transport.rx_ownership: transport-owned until explicit take; only successful RX copied to caller
transport.arbitration: round robin per accepted transaction; measurement pair and display command/data may release bus between transactions

abi: V003 and X035 structural profiles, no startup/real IRQ/stack peak; touched buffers and fake counters included
